admission_units.change_rule: An explicit requirement/candidate counterexample and recorded replacement is required to change this denominator.

policy: All HYLE operator algorithms on CPU/CUDA/Metal/Vulkan frozen until M5; no self expansion/research/optimization/performance before third-party integration gate.

CPU-G.mode: borrow upstream graph/composite or fused op as a retained backend region
CPU-G.product_binding: BLOCKED by existing context/threadpool failure seam; no full backend binding
conditions: M1-G patch-factor audit before original owner resumes
ggml rank <=4: higher rank needs proven fold/segmentation, never silently reduce requirement
check actual dispatch/type, supports_op default true is insufficient
F32 state/intermediate where upstream requires it; rounding contract still mandatory

CPU-D.mode: primitive/Graph partition; mature reorder and bounded tile decode composed with floating MatMul
CPU-D.product_binding: BRGEMM/norm/post-ops subset exists; Q2 BLOCKED remains, new numeric domains UNPROVEN
conditions: preserve original Q4/Q8/FP8 codes/scales
no A8 requant for W8A16
reorder FP4/FP8 source exists at product pin; exact block-scale composition and ISA execution unverified

CPU-I.mode: existing library exclusive_scan/stable_sort and checked host-index boundary, followed by provider gather/scatter
CPU-I.product_binding: planned; no HYLE sorting/scan kernel research
conditions: checked I32 overflow before narrowing
count/index buffers are CPU-route data
duplicate reduction/stability must match requirement

CUDA-G.mode: retained native backend region and graph memory plan on the selected GPU
conditions: native stream/buffer export/import needs narrow runtime bridge
SSM convolution channel dimension multiple 128
GDN accepted on CUDA, not a claim for MUSA
TopK >1024 needs qualified CUB path
F32 HC intermediates; flash/indexer actual supports_op guards
independent pin rejects I32/I16 DUP while llama bundled pin accepts: qualify migration rather than interchange pins

CUDA-A.mode: fixed C++/CUDA prefill/decode/attention region with native stream and prepared workspace
conditions: SM89 machine explicitly qualified, not all README feature rows apply
head256 decode cannot be inherited from cuDNN head<=128 domain
Windows/MSVC and exact cache/mask/accumulation unverified
no Python/Torch product dependency or runtime autotuning

CUDA-Q.mode: reuse mature GEMM/quant programs; lossless packing or bounded upstream decode + GEMM where profile differs
CUDA-Q.product_binding: several narrow providers exist; all admitted profiles still UNPROVEN
conditions: SM89 rowwise FP8 is not proof of block128 FP8
use exact upstream quantizers/format decode; no new quant kernel
W8A16 forbids activation requant
F18.3/4 cannot substitute native MXFP4 W4A16 for required W4A8
if no legal upstream block composition, hold named Q-FP8; do not implement custom algorithm

CUDA-I.mode: native CUB scan/sort/histogram building blocks and ggml index region
CUDA-I.product_binding: CUB dependency exists; full checked/stable coverage UNPROVEN
conditions: stock DeviceScan/DeviceRadixSort/DeviceHistogram APIs
required validation and GPU completion stay included
do not extend frozen HYLE custom scatter/scan/sort code

APPLE-M.mode: public C++ typed/compiled array region; existing operations composed at graph boundary
APPLE-M.product_binding: broad subset already bound; mapping is not final coverage
conditions: device remains Metal; functional state outputs retain old leases
tie/NaN/rounding and dtype promotions independently qualified
exact compile cache and stream ownership reuse

APPLE-G.mode: complete upstream recurrent/sparse/MoE graph region; narrow native resource bridge
APPLE-G.product_binding: not integrated; distinct runtime from MLX
conditions: GDN needs simdgroup reduction and value head multiple32
flash/indexer dtype/head limits checked on Air/Mini
mHC pre/post HC4 and F32
same-GPU MLX/ggml boundary must preserve buffers, explicit synchronization and lifetime; no hidden CPU compute

APPLE-Q.product_binding: source APIs present at current product pin; exact C0 formats unqualified
conditions: affine and symmetric packing must preserve logical codes/scales
qqmm nvfp4 default is not automatic MXFP4/W4A8 equivalence
dynamic scales/rounding and SiTU requant verified separately
bound tile workspace, no whole-model floating residence

VK-G.mode: extend existing managed backend region with upstream model graph operations/fusions
VK-G.product_binding: managed region and selected basics already bound; 64-domain closure UNPROVEN
conditions: GDN six F32 inputs/output, value heads16/32/64/128
solve_tri workgroup/shared-memory bounds
get_rows_back F32 only; F32 scan is not checked I32 exclusive scan
lightning indexer head128/alignment/fp16 requirements
check native RTX4070 and Air/MoltenVK independently

VK-C.mode: offline-compiled parameterized standard-op region; C runtime wraps native VkDevice/buffer and completion
VK-C.product_binding: not integrated or run; source seam and standard scan/FP8 emulation identified
conditions: Q-VK must prove exact E4M3/E2M1/UE8 and I32 operations on both devices
Vulkan1.3 baseline/timeline/scalarBlockLayout/synchronization2 must hold on MoltenVK
compiler is build tool; native SDK runtime must not require Python/model loader
only upstream standard operations/type legalization, no handwritten MLIR math kernel or tuning schedule
bounded tile region and compressed weights, never whole-model float expansion
if qualification fails, test named ncnn/MNN/upstream alternatives; no self authorization

NATIVE-BOUNDARY.provider: HYLE resource/planning boundary + route native runtime
NATIVE-BOUNDARY.mode: bind and validate descriptors/effects/leases/constant cache/fixed rules; delegate all mathematical execution
NATIVE-BOUNDARY.owner: compute / graph and corresponding route owners
NATIVE-BOUNDARY.product_binding: foundation exists; new model/version rules and full provider lifecycle coverage required
conditions: not a universal executor/queue or per-kernel vtable
model/config/phase + device/SM/driver/toolkit/OS/provider/rule versions in relevant identity
prepare matches/binds; execution never probes/searches/times
CMake one dependency declaration, source/static/shared, route OFF isolation
ordinary API receives semantic views/graph, never provider ranking

status_boundary: Map and integration order are reviewable. Backend domain qualification, native binding, correctness, delivery and performance remain distinct uncompleted gates.
